title: Microsoft previews Surface Laptop Ultra, local AI
excerpt: Forget cloud latency. Microsoft's new hardware is built to run powerful, autonomous AI helpers directly on your machine.
content_html:
Watch Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella and the Windows team introduce the next era for the OS, including more trustworthy AI agents, the Surface Laptop Ultra and Nvidia-powered laptops and PCs for creators and developers.

Read more about Microsoft's Surface Laptop Ultra: Microsoft's Surface Laptop Ultra is an AI supercomputer dressed as a laptop
Microsoft created a magnetic USB-C port, and you need to see it for yourself
